'''Loovria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] along the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] known for its [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] pits.

==History==
It was on Loovria that jaded Senex and Juvex nobles-sometimes joined by rich, well connected outsiders-watched [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and prisoners fight for their lives. [[Gladiator/Legends|Gladiators]] whose bravery caught the nobles' fancy were sometimes granted their freedom and showered with riches.<ref name="Forsale">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Fighters for Sale}}</ref>

[[Slssk]] spent 10 years as a gladiator on Loovria. [[Quintik Kahr]] and his brother [[Omze'kehr Kahr]] were also gladiators on the planet for a time, as was the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] known as the [[Great Goblin]].
